certified_services.serviceDescription: Akeyless is an identity security platform for machines, autonomous agents, and humans that unifies secrets management, privileged access, certificate lifecycle management, encryption keys and AI agent runtime controls on a Zero-Knowledge cryptographic foundation.

American Intelligence Corporation (AIC) provides an advanced AI infrastructure platform designed to automate complex systems integration, data processing, and operational workflows for mission-critical operations across public sector and defense agencies.

Clearview AI is a facial recognition intelligence platform featuring a database of billions of public web images. It empowers law enforcement and government agencies to rapidly identify suspects, generate investigative leads, and enhance public safety.

Cohere is an enterprise-grade AI platform that builds frontier large language models and semantic retrieval systems. It enables businesses to integrate advanced text generation, natural language processing, and AI search directly into secure applications.

DailyPay is a financial technology solution that seamlessly integrates with enterprise payroll software to give employees real-time, on-demand access to their earned wages, enhancing financial wellness and driving workforce retention for employers.

DataRobot is an enterprise AI platform designed to accelerate end-to-end machine learning. It automates the development, deployment, continuous monitoring, and governance of predictive analytics and generative AI applications at scale across businesses.

DataOS (by The Modern Data Company) is a data operating system that unifies, governs, and transforms fragmented enterprise data architectures into standardized, AI-ready data products without requiring the replacement of existing legacy infrastructure.

Dropzone AI is an Agentic SOC platform that deploys autonomous AI security analysts. Working alongside human teams, these agents investigate alerts across core security tools to deliver scalable threat coverage and detailed, verifiable evidence reports.

JetStream Security is an AI governance and security platform that offers deep visibility, identity access management, and real-time runtime guardrails, empowering enterprises to safely deploy, monitor, and control AI workflows and autonomous agents.

Kaizen builds the application layer for America’s mission-critical services, helping federal agencies replace legacy systems with AI-native applications. It combines government-ready primitives with AI-powered configuration to deploy in weeks, not months or years.

MCheck (by HiLabs) is an AI-driven healthcare data clearinghouse platform that automates complex provider data workflows. It eliminates errors, improves directory accuracy, streamlines roster ingestion, and optimizes operational efficiency for health plans.

Onebrief is a collaborative mission-planning platform that unifies real-time operational data, staff workflows, and decision intelligence into a single interface to accelerate command-and-control processes across defense and coalition operations.

current.service_desc:
2F Game Warden is a fully managed and compliant multi-tenant DevSecOps platform that accelerates the delivery of commercial cloud software to federal government customers, State, Local, and Education (SLED) agencies, and highly regulated industries. Engineered to support dual compliance pathways, Game Warden can be leveraged as a pre-authorized FedRAMP PaaS for external systems or utilized for fully in-boundary application hosting. Built to provide Fort Knox-level infrastructure security, customer workloads deploy natively on our managed infrastructure across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) utilizing Kubernetes containers. The platform fully automates continuous monitoring, threat mitigation, vulnerability scanning, patch management, and control inheritance required to conform to strict cybersecurity standards across the full compliance spectrum—FedRAMP, DoW, and GovRAMP. Second Front Systems handles 100% of the underlying infrastructure maintenance, enabling commercial SaaS technology to rapidly scale across public sector and regulated missions without the overhead of building traditional compliance frameworks from scratch.
